crem.translation: abbr. cremation 烧, 火葬; cremor (Latin=cream) （拉丁语）乳剂

cremains.definition: n. the remains of a dead body after cremation

cremaster.definition:
n. A thin muscle which serves to draw up the testicle.
n. The apex of the last abdominal segment of an insect.

cremasteric.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to the cremaster; as, the cremasteric
   artery.

cremated.translation: v. 火葬, 火化（尸体）( cremate的过去式和过去分词 )

cremates.translation: v. 火葬, 火化（尸体）( cremate的第三人称单数 )

cremating.translation: v. 火葬, 火化（尸体）( cremate的现在分词 )

cremation.definition: n. the incineration of a dead body
cremation.translation:
n. 烧, 火葬
[医] 火葬

cremationist.definition: n. One who advocates the practice of cremation.
cremationist.translation: n. 火葬论者, 主张火葬的人

cremations.definition: n. the incineration of a dead body

cremator.definition: n. One who, or that which, cremates or consumes to ashes.
cremator.translation: n. 焚尸人, 焚尸炉

crematoria.definition:
n. a mortuary where corpses are cremated
n. a furnace where a corpse can be burned and reduced to ashes
crematoria.translation: n. 火葬场( crematorium的复数形式 )

crematories.translation: n. 火葬场( crematory的名词复数 )

crematorium.definition:
n a mortuary where corpses are cremated
n a furnace where a corpse can be burned and reduced to ashes
crematorium.translation:
n. 焚尸炉, 火葬场
a. 火葬的

crematoriums.translation: n. 火葬场( crematorium的名词复数 )

crematory.definition:
n. a mortuary where corpses are cremated
n. a furnace where a corpse can be burned and reduced to ashes
crematory.translation:
n. 火葬场, (尸体或垃圾的)焚化炉
a. 火葬的

creme.translation: n. 奶油调味液, 乳剂, 香甜的酒

creme anglais.translation: [网络] 一种法式甜点；浸在英式蛋奶酱

creme de la creme.translation: n. <法>精华，最优秀分子，最好部分

cremer.translation: 克里默(①姓氏 ②Sir William Randal, 1838-1908, 英国政治家、和平主义者, 曾获1903年诺贝尔和平奖)

cremin.translation: [人名] [爱尔兰姓氏] 克雷明盖尔语姓氏的英语形式，来源于别名，含义是“弯曲的”(bent,crooked)

cremo-bismuth.translation: [医] 铋乳(膏)(成药,含氢氧化铋和次碳酸铋)

cremo-carbonates.translation: [医] 碳酸盐乳膏(成药,含碳酸镁,次硝酸铋,碳酸钙和氯仿水)

cremocarp.definition:
n. The peculiar fruit of fennel, carrot, parsnip, and the
   like, consisting of a pair of carpels pendent from a supporting axis.

cremona.definition: n. a city in Lombardy on the Po River; noted for the manufacture of fine violins from the 16th to the 18th centuries
cremona.translation: n. 克雷莫纳（意大利城市）

cremor.definition: n. Cream; a substance resembling cream; yeast; scum.
cremor.translation: [医] 乳油, 乳皮; 乳膏, 霜

cremor tartari.translation: [医] 酒石, 酒石酸氢钾

crems.translation: (crem 的复数) abbr. cremation 烧, 火葬; cremor (Latin=cream) （拉丁语）乳剂
